nodes.speaker: Junie
nodes.text: Oh good, you're up. Okay, don't freak out, but I need a second opinion on something conspiratorial.

options.text: I wasn't going to freak out.
[Say nothing. Wait for her to continue.]

nodes.speaker: Junie
nodes.text: Tomas Reyes. Third-year, plays the world's saddest trumpet, hasn't been to breakfast in four days. Missing-poster levels of missing. Look at my board.

nodes.speaker: Junie
nodes.text: Someone drew a little bell next to his photo and then tried to erase it. That's not nothing.

nodes.speaker: Junie
nodes.text: Okay, hear me out. Not saying it's the lake. But it's kind of always the lake.

options.text: That's not a theory, that's a location.

nodes.speaker: Junie
nodes.text: Rude, but accurate, which is worse. Look — I've got a photo club excuse to hang around the lake path with a camera. You want in?

options.text: Fine. Show me what you've got.

nodes.speaker: Junie
nodes.text: Okay, this one I haven't even shown the photo club. Corner of the frame, one of the dusk shots. Somebody standing dead still by the reeds. I only noticed on the third pass.
